source_record.description:
Your mission

As a Quantitative Backend Developer (f/m/d), you will build analytics APIs and backend services for our Analytics products. You will combine quantitative methods with modern software engineering and ensure that analytical solutions are scalable, high-performing, and production-ready. Your Tasks:

Analytics Engineering & Implementation

  • Design, develop, and enhance analytics APIs and backend services for our Analytics products
  • Transform quantitative models, research outcomes, and prototypes into production-ready Python code
  • Further develop our analytics production and data processing environment
  • Build robust and scalable software components for analytical calculations
  • Collaborate closely with Quantitative Specialists to operationalize new models and methodologies
Data Management & System Integration
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to databases, internal platforms, and downstream systems
  • Process, transform, and make financial, fund, and portfolio data available
  • Analyze and optimize data flows and analytics processes
  • Ensure reliable, efficient, and scalable execution of analytical calculations
Operations & Quality Assurance
  • Ensure the ongoing quality assurance of quantitative model outputs for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support the onboarding of new clients in relation to our analytics products and models
  • Analyze and resolve complex technical issues in production environments
  • Create and maintain technical documentation
Collaboration & Communication
  • Collaborate with Quantitative Specialists, Product Managers, Engineering, and Operations teams
  • Translate business and quantitative requirements into technical solutions
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical concepts
  • Evaluate and integrate new technologies and development approaches


Your profile

How You Work

  • You enjoy building robust technical solutions for complex analytical challenges
  • You think in terms of data flows, interfaces, and interconnected systems
  • You value maintainable and high-quality code
  • You are curious about agentic development or already have initial experience integrating AI-supported development approaches into software development processes
  • You work in a structured, independent, and pragmatic way
  • You take ownership and proactively drive topics forward
  • You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and communicating transparently
  • You are motivated by transforming analytical ideas into production-ready applications
Your Qualifications
  • Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Data Science, or comparable discipline
  • Initial professional experience in backend, API, or data-driven software development
  • Strong Python programming skills
  • Experience developing APIs and backend systems
  • Experience working with databases and data processing systems
  • Basic understanding of mathematical and statistical models
  • Knowledge of software quality, testing, and version control
  • Experience with financial data or private capital is a plus
Languages
  • Very good English skills (working language)
  • German is a plus


Our offer

  • Exciting challenges and excellent development opportunities in a constantly growing, international team
  • Freedom to develop own ideas and thus make an active contribution to the success of our company
  • Attractive remuneration with variable components as part of a total compensation system
  • Great colleagues, a friendly working atmosphere and numerous employee events
  • Modern workplace in the heart of Munich with view of the Theresienwiese
  • Modern employee benefits - bike leasing, meal vouchers, BAV, Deutschlandticket, benefits account & Wellpass Fitness
  • Hybrid working model 
  • Free drinks and fruit as well as a well-filled ice box in summer
